input: A resident asks how to register a change of address. Answer in two sentences.
output: To register a change of address, visit your local government website or contact your municipal office to obtain the necessary forms. Complete the form with your new address and submit it in person or by mail, depending on local requirements.

input: Hello, I cannot sign in to the citizen portal any more. My password reset email never arrives. I have a residence appointment at the Bierger-Center tomorrow at 09:00 and I need the confirmation letter from my account before then. Please help today.

Bonjour, l'imprimante du service technique au deuxieme etage n'imprime plus depuis lundi. Elle affiche une erreur de bourrage papier alors qu'il n'y a pas de papier coince. Nous en aurons besoin pour la seance du conseil, donc au plus tard le 15/09/2026. Merci.

Guten Tag, auf unserer letzten Rechnung fuer die Kantinennutzung steht ein Betrag von 480 Euro, wir haben aber nur elf Mittagessen bestellt. Koennen Sie das bitte pruefen und gegebenenfalls korrigieren? Es eilt nicht.

The main entrance door of the Bierger-Center did not lock last night. It is standing open right now and anyone can walk into the building, including the room where the archive boxes are kept. Someone needs to come immediately.

Bonjour, ma nouvelle collegue commence lundi au service population. Pourriez-vous lui creer un compte sur le portail interne et lui donner acces au dossier partage du service? Ce n'est pas urgent, mais ce serait bien avant la fin du mois.

Just so you know: from the next billing cycle our supplier reference on the water invoices changes from LU-COM-4417 to LU-COM-4419. No action needed from your side, I am only informing the help desk so nobody is surprised.
